Checked: the unique root of (1−q⁻¹)² = Vol(4₁)/(m_μ/m_e) with CODATA-2022 206.7682827 is 1.109978595642739… (matches the live anchor). The md's "q = 1.1097 ± 0.001" contains it (difference 2.8e−4), but 1.10998 does not round to 1.1097. prf: uniqueness argument (f(q) = (1−q⁻¹)² strictly increasing) is correct.
